en: I read a new book yesterday.
I didn't read this book yesterday.
You (m.) read the newspaper in the morning.
You (m.) didn't read my message.
You (f.) read the whole story today.
You (f.) didn't read the exam sheet.

He didn't study his lesson well.
She read a very nice book.
She didn't read her brother's letter.
We studied the lessons at night.
We didn't read the article in the magazine.
You (pl.) read the book with the teacher.

lat: ma qritush l-akhbar l-yum f s-sba7
en: You (pl.) didn't read the news this morning.
They read a lot of books.
They didn't read the address well.
I study at the university now.
I don't read magazines at home.
You (m.) read a big book every day.
You (m.) don't read your story now.
You (f.) study with your friend in the room.
You (f.) don't study your lesson today.
He reads the book slowly.
He doesn't study at school today.

en: She doesn't study her lessons at night.
We study in the library every afternoon.
We don't read children's stories.
You (pl.) study a lot before the exam.

en: You (pl.) don't read this book in class.
They study Arabic here.

lat: ma kayqrawsh kul lila f d-dar
en: They don't read every night at home.
I am going to read this story tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish nqra had l-ktab l-lila
ar: ما غاديش نقرا هاد الكتاب الليلة
en: I am not going to read this book tonight.

lat: ghadi tqra d-dars dyalek f l-lil
en: You (m.) are going to study your lesson at night.
You (m.) are not going to read the newspaper today.
You (f.) are going to study with your sister tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish tqray had l-bra l-yum
ar: ما غاديش تقراي هاد البرا اليوم
en: You (f.) are not going to read this letter today.

lat: ghadi yqra f fransa l-3am j-jay
en: He is going to study in France next year.
He is not going to study the lesson now.

lat: ghadi tqra ktab jdid f s-sif
en: She is going to read a new book in the summer.

lat: ma ghadish tqra f r-rbat l-3am j-jay
ar: ما غاديش تقرا فالرباط العام الجاي
en: She is not going to study in Rabat next year.
We are going to study the rules in class.

lat: ma ghadish nqraw had l-majalla l-yum
ar: ما غاديش نقراو هاد المجلة اليوم
en: We are not going to read this magazine today.
You (pl.) are going to read your book tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish tqraw f l-3otla dyal s-sif
ar: ما غاديش تقراو فالعطلة ديال الصيف
en: You (pl.) are not going to study during the summer holiday.
They are going to read the news on the phone.

lat: ma ghadish yqraw l-werqa dyal t-tebib
ar: ما غاديش يقراو الورقة ديال الطبيب
en: They are not going to read the doctor's note.
